This plot is small, only small like my backyard, but millet is our food so I must manage it well. I will put small fertilizer because the land is getting tired, but I cannot buy too much — money is not there. I keep my own millet seed from last harvest like my father did, it grows well here with the rain we get. I also put the manure from my goats and sheep because it helps, and I intercrop with cowpea so the soil stays good. My wife and children help me with weeding and harvest, and maybe I call one or two neighbours for the weeding time when the grass is too much.
